title: Hottel Memo
summary: A one-page memo of 22 March 1950 from Guy Hottel, head of the FBI's Washington field office, to J. Edgar Hoover, passing on a third party's story that an Air Force investigator said three "flying saucers" with three-foot-tall occupants had been recovered in New Mexico. It is the most viewed file in the FBI Vault; the FBI says it never investigated the claim and sees no reason to link it to Roswell.

tree.title: Flying saucers, information concerning
tree.summary: Office memorandum of March 22, 1950 from Guy Hottel, SAC Washington, to the FBI Director. A redacted source told an agent that an Air Force investigator said three flying saucers about 50 feet across were recovered in New Mexico, each holding three 3-foot bodies in fine metallic cloth. Government radar reportedly disrupted their controls. No further evaluation followed.
